title: SPELLSPIRE
description: A roguelike deckbuilder. Climb a three-act spire with a deck of spells, read every enemy's intent, collect relics and potions, and build combos with burn, frost and expose until the Spire Heart falls.
controls:
Click a card to play it, then click an enemy if it needs a target (or drag cards onto enemies)
Keys: 1-9 pick cards, ← → choose targets, Enter plays, E ends the turn, P potions, D deck, Esc menu
Touch: tap a card, then tap it again or tap an enemy
Controller: D-pad picks, A plays, B cancels, X ends the turn

title: DEEPCRAWL
description: A turn-based roguelike. Pick a warrior, rogue or mage and descend ten floors of a freshly carved dungeon. Level up with perks, find better gear, drink potions, read scrolls and face the Lich King. Includes a daily descent.
controls:
Move and attack: WASD or arrows (Q E Z C diagonals)
Space waits · 1 2 abilities · 3-9 items · X explores · Enter descends · M map · Esc menu
Touch: tap a tile to walk, tap an enemy next to you to attack
Controller: stick moves, A waits, X and Y abilities, RB explores

title: BARRAGE
description: Turn-based artillery on destructible terrain. Read the wind, set your angle and power, and pick from ten weapons, from heavy shells and splitters to napalm, rollers and diggers. Fight sharp CPU gunners or friends in hotseat battles for up to four.
controls:
Drag on the battlefield to aim (direction = angle, distance = power)
Keys: ← → aim, ↑ ↓ power (Shift for fine control), A D drive, Q E weapon, Space fire
Touch: drag to aim, use the panel buttons, tap FIRE
Controller: D-pad aims and sets power, stick drives, LB/RB weapon, A fires

title: ISLEWRIGHT
description: A calm island builder. Place houses, mills, farms, markets and lighthouses where their neighbours make them score, reach goals to unlock new building packs, and sail on to fresh islands. Every spot matters.
controls:
Pick a building at the bottom, hover to preview its points, click to build
Keys: arrows move a cursor, Enter builds, 1-9 or Tab picks a building, U undoes
Touch: tap to preview, tap again to build, drag to pan, pinch to zoom
Controller: D-pad moves, A builds, LB/RB picks, Y undoes

title: HOPPER
description: Hop across endless roads, rivers and rail lines. Dodge traffic, ride the logs, watch for trains and keep ahead of the fog. Collect coins to unlock ten critters, or try the daily path.
controls:
Hop: arrows or WASD (Space hops forward)
Touch: tap to hop forward, swipe to hop sideways or back
Esc: pause
Controller works too

title: BLASTZONE
description: An arena bomber for up to four. Blast crates, grab power-ups like kick and shield, and outlast three bots, or bring a friend on the same keyboard or with controllers. Three arenas and sudden death.
controls:
One player: WASD or arrows move, Space drops a bomb
Two players: P1 WASD + Space, P2 arrows + Enter
Controllers: stick moves, A drops a bomb
Touch: on-screen pad and bomb button

title: SUNSET DRIVE
description: An arcade road racer into the sunset. Beat the clock through five stages of coast, city, desert, mountains and neon, weaving past traffic for close-call bonuses. Or switch off the clock and just cruise.
controls:
Accelerate: ↑ / W   Brake: ↓ / S   Steer: ← →
Touch: the car accelerates by itself, hold the buttons to steer
Controller: stick steers, A or RT gas, B or LT brake
Esc: pause

title: TEE TIME
description: Mini golf with 18 hand-built holes: windmills, bumpers, bridges, slopes, sliding gates, sand and water. Play the full course, either nine, or practice single holes, alone or with up to four players.
controls:
Press anywhere, drag back and let go to putt
Keys: ← → aim, ↑ ↓ power, Space putts
Controller: stick aims, triggers set power, A putts
Esc: menu and scorecard

title: PRISMBREAK
description: A neon brick breaker with 24 levels across three worlds. Prism bricks split your ball in three, bombs chain together, and ten power-ups include lasers, fireballs and multiball. Earn three stars per level, or play the endless mode.
controls:
Mouse or finger moves the paddle
Click, tap or Space launches the ball and fires lasers
← → also move the paddle   Esc: pause
Controller works too

title: NEON SURGE
description: A twin-stick arena shooter on a warping neon grid. Fight nine kinds of enemies, pick up sparks to raise your multiplier, and clear the screen with bombs. Play Arena, a three-minute Rush, or the Daily.
controls:
Move: WASD   Aim: mouse (fires on its own)
Arrow keys also shoot   Bomb: Space or right-click
Controller: left stick moves, right stick shoots
Touch: left thumb moves, right thumb shoots

title: STARLANCE
description: A vertical bullet-hell shooter. Weave through three stages of glowing patterns and beat three bosses with twelve named attacks. Graze bullets for points, focus for precision, and bomb when it gets tight. Three difficulties and practice mode.
controls:
Move: arrows / WASD   Focus: Shift
Fire: automatic (or Z)   Bomb: X   Pause: Esc
Touch: drag to steer, double-tap to bomb
Controller works too

title: VORTEX
description: A fast reflex game. Orbit the core and slip through the gaps as walls close in from every side. Earn a new rank every ten seconds, and last a minute to unlock the next of six levels.
controls:
Turn: ← → or A D
Touch: hold the left or right half of the screen
Space or tap: retry right away   Esc: menu
Controller: D-pad, stick or bumpers

title: PATIENCE
description: Three solitaire games in one: Klondike (draw 1 or 3), Spider (1, 2 or 4 suits) and FreeCell with numbered deals. Klondike deals can always be won, hints come from a solver, and you get unlimited undo, daily deals and stats.
controls:
Drag cards, or click one to send it to the best spot
Click the stock to draw (or deal in Spider)
H: hint   Ctrl+Z: undo   N: new deal
Keyboard, controller and touch work too

title: GAMBIT
description: Chess against a built-in engine with eight levels, from beginner to strong, or with a friend on one device. It has hints, takebacks, optional clocks, a rating that grows as you win, game review and PGN export.
controls:
Drag a piece, or click it and then its target square
Right-drag to draw arrows
H: hint   F: flip   Ctrl+Z: takeback   Esc: menu
Home / End and [ ] step through the moves

title: JADE
description: Mahjong solitaire. Match free tiles in pairs to clear five layouts, from the classic Tortoise to Fortress and Twin Peaks. Every deal can be solved, and a shuffle keeps it that way if you get stuck.
controls:
Click two matching free tiles to remove them
H: hint   S: shuffle   Ctrl+Z: undo
Arrows + Enter pick tiles with the keyboard
Controller and touch work too

title: GLOOP
description: Drop squishy slimes into a tank. Two of a kind merge into the next size, and quick chains score combos. Grow all eleven slimes up to the King Gloop before the tank overflows.
controls:
Aim with the mouse and click to drop
Touch: drag to aim, let go to drop
← → aim, Space drops, X shakes the tank
Controller works too

title: STACKFALL
description: A fast falling-block puzzle game. It has modern rotation with wall kicks, hold, ghost pieces, T-spins, combos and perfect clears. Modes: Marathon, a 40-line Sprint, 2-minute Ultra, Dig, Zen and a Daily Sprint. Keys and handling can be changed.
controls:
Move: ← →   Soft drop: ↓   Hard drop: Space
Rotate: ↑ / X and Z / Ctrl   180°: A   Hold: C / Shift
Pause: Esc   Restart: R   (all keys can be changed)
Controller and touch work too

title: DEFUSE
description: Minesweeper with no-guess boards: every board can be cleared by logic alone, and your first click is always safe. Play Beginner, Intermediate, Expert, custom sizes or the daily board, with chording, hints, zoom and records.
controls:
Left click: open   Right click: flag
Click a number to open around it (chord)
Arrows + Space / F also work   H: hint   Scroll: zoom
Touch: tap to open, hold to flag, pinch to zoom

title: NINEFOLD
description: Sudoku graded by the techniques each puzzle needs, from Easy to Expert. It has notes, auto-notes, undo, mistake checking and hints that explain the logic, plus a daily puzzle and stats.
controls:
Click a cell, then a number (or type 1-9)
Notes: N or Shift+number   Fill notes: A
Undo: Ctrl+Z   Erase: Backspace   Hint: H
Controller and touch work too

title: INKGRID
description: Picture logic puzzles (nonograms). Use the number clues to ink in a hidden picture, then watch it fill with color. There are 24 hand-drawn puzzles in three packs, endless random puzzles and a daily 15 × 15, all solvable without guessing.
controls:
Left drag: ink   Right drag: cross out
Arrows + hold Z / X to ink or cross
H: hint   Ctrl+Z: undo   Esc: menu
Touch: pick Fill or Cross, then tap or drag

title: Last Lantern
description: A pixel-art survival roguelite. Your weapons fire on their own, so dodge the swarm, pick upgrades, evolve your weapons and survive 15 minutes until dawn. Unlock six keepers, three stages with bosses, and a daily night.
controls:
Move: WASD / arrows / stick / drag on touch
Weapons attack on their own
Level up: click a card, or 1-4
Pause: Esc / P / Start

title: GRIDLOCK
description: Neon tower defense on a new grid every game. Build and upgrade nine towers, hold the core for 30 waves or go endless, then design your own maps in the editor and share them as codes.
controls:
Build: pick a tower (1-9), then click a free tile
Click a tower to upgrade (U), sell (S) or retarget (T)
Space: next wave   F: speed   Esc: pause
Controller and touch work too

title: STARFORGE
description: An idle game about forging stardust. Click the star, build a solar system of 14 forges, catch golden comets, then go supernova for remnants and light constellations. It keeps forging while you're away.
controls:
Click the star (or press Space) to forge stardust
Buy forges and upgrades in the side panel
Catch golden comets when they fly past
Saves automatically

title: MOMENTUM
description: A pixel-art speedrun platformer. Chain jumps, wall kicks and dashes to keep your speed, race your own ghost through 10 levels with live splits, then build levels in the editor and share them as codes.
controls:
Move: Arrows / WASD
Jump: Space / Z
Dash: X / Shift (aim with a direction)
Restart level: R   Pause: Esc
Controller and touch work too

title: OCTIVE
description: A fast vertical-scrolling rhythm game. Hit the notes as they reach the line, climb the global rankings, take on the daily charts, and import your own .oct or osu! beatmaps.
controls:
4 keys: D F J K (change them in Settings → Input)
Works best in fullscreen
